stage_title: Carried from the v2 question list, 2026-09-11
item: In-tank pump draw at target pressure
note: Done 2026-09-22 from makers' current curves at 13.5 V, assuming the stock LS returnless 58 psi (400 kPa) - the record gives no target pressure. Draw at 58 psi: Walbro/TI GSS342 255 lph ~8.9 A; Aeromotive Phantom 340 (HO12's candidate) ~12.2 A, 13 A max per the maker; AEM 50-1200 340 lph ~12-13.4 A; TI F90000267/274 450 lph ~15.3 A (19 A at its 112 psi relief). At 43.5 psi: 7.7 / 11.5 / ~12 / 14.3 A. +~7 % at 14.4 V, more on E85. O5 is a 25 A channel: any 255/340 pump fits; the 450 lph is the only one that crowds it. Sources: autoperformanceengineering.com/html/fpspecs.html, strikeengine.com (13.5 V bench test), aeromotiveinc.com efi-returnless-phantom-340, fuelsafe.com F90000274. Interpolated values are confirm; the installed pump's draw at the regulated pressure is measured before O5's soft fuse is set (D-173, R11), and its inrush term re-checked.
